name: Steel and Sash
description: Valeriy's outfit. As an officer, he must often engage in both frontline combat and command work, and as such, durability is a must for his uniform. And as the commander of the Special Assignments Battalion, Armory Palace Royal Grenadier Guards, First Regiment, he must also grace some official settings with his presence, and so he must also dress with suitable gravitas. This outfit, therefore, was custom-tailored to fulfil both duties at once, which cuts down on time required to change uniforms.
